thread:
Emily (Growth): Hey team — need a quick art pass for the May webinar + supporting funnel visuals. Deliverables: hero slide (1920x1080), webinar social card (1200x628), 3-step funnel diagram (vector SVG + PNG), and a one-pager 8.5x11 PDF. Due EOD next Tuesday if possible. Please flag any brand/legal blockers.
Mike D. (Design Lead): Got it. Can you drop the headline/copy you want on hero and the webinar title? Also confirm file naming convention.
Emily (Growth): Title: "Inference Economics: Cost, Latency, and Serving Tradeoffs". Hero headline: "Make inference predictable and economical" Subhead for slide: "Live: Wed, May 15 — 10am PT" Copy for social: 1-line tease + CTA: "Join the webinar — register now". Naming: rwdn_webinar_inference_2024_[asset].
Tom K. (Marketing Ops): Routing note — we need an alternate square 800x800 for socials, and Marketo requires the 1200x628 PNG and a 600x315 for LinkedIn carousel. Also add a hidden alt text field for accessibility.
Mike D. (Design Lead): Perfect. Quick Qs: 1) Should funnel diagram match the long-form benchmark visual style or a simplified schematic? 2) Do we want to show cost numbers or keep qualitative bands?
Emily (Growth): Keep it simplified schematic for the funnel (3 lanes: Ingest -> Routing/Caching -> Serving). Use qualitative bands (Low/Med/High) rather than exact $ numbers — avoids premature commitment.
Jess R. (Brand): Brand checks: use Redwood primary (HEX #0066FF) + neutral greys, Inter variable for headings, Source Sans for body. Do NOT alter logomark spacing — send comps with 3 logo placement options for legal. Also: follow our accessible contrast thresholds, and include alt text.
Mike D. (Design Lead): On it. I'll mock 2 hero treatments (bold headline overlay + illustration background) and 1 clean slide with diagram. Will post Figma link by EOD tomorrow. Any required imagery for the background?
Emily (Growth): Prefer abstract GPU/hardware pattern over stock photos. Keep people/face imagery out for compliance.
legal-bot: Automated reminder: Any customer logos or partner mentions require written approval. If we include customer callouts in the one-pager, tag legal for review.
Tom K. (Marketing Ops): Also we need a small lead-gen CTA asset (300x250) for the webinar landing page. Can we reuse the hero layout?
Mike D. (Design Lead): Yes will create responsive variants. Pro tip: I'll export SVG for funnel so Product can reuse it in docs.
Jess R. (Brand): When you post Figma, include a version note: "webinar_may2024_v1 — for brand review". I'll do a quick sweep once comps are ready.
Emily (Growth): Thanks — timeline recap: Figma comps tomorrow EOD, final assets by next Tuesday EOD. If legal flags anything, we'll triage. Tag me in Figma. :thumbsup:
Mike D. (Design Lead): Roger. Adding checklist: export sizes 1920x1080, 1200x628, 800x800, 600x315, 300x250; deliver SVG+PNG for diagram; one-pager PDF. Will post prototypes with notes.
Jess R. (Brand): Noted — I'll prioritize the review to keep to timeline.
Tom K. (Marketing Ops): I'll prep Marketo slot and set up tracking params (utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=inference_may2024). Drop final asset filenames here when ready.
Emily (Growth): Thanks all — tagging @Mike D., @Jess R., @Tom K. for follow-up.
Mike D. (Design Lead): Figma link (WIP): https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/inference-webinar-may2024 — will update with comments.
legal-bot: If any customer logos are proposed later, run a request: /legal-approve with pdf + usage context.
Emily (Growth): Closing note: include a 1-line speaker credit area on the hero (e.g., "Hosted by Redwood Inference — speakers from Product & Research"). Keep it small.
Mike D. (Design Lead): Will do. Thanks everyone.
